File paths from config…

config <- yaml::read_yaml("config/config.yaml")

# Fill templates
paths <- lapply(config$paths, function(path) {
  if (grepl("\\{chrom\\}|\\{chrom_no_prefix\\}", path)) {
    return(NULL)   # skip chrom-templated paths
  }
  glue(path,
       data_dir       = config$paths$data_dir,
       singletons_dir = config$paths$singletons_dir
  )
})

paths <- Filter(Negate(is.null), paths)

Paths and information from the dated trees

ts_tsv <- params$ts_tsv

3 Data

We read in the relevant data from chromosomes - Generated using gel_ts-df.Rmd

# Extract relevant columns from the ts_df for all chromosomes
selected_columns <- c(
    "chromosome",
    "position",
    "ts_name",
    "AC_ts",
    "AF_ts",
    "shape_time",
    "scale_time",
    "mean_time",
    "singleton_sample_id",
    "panel_app_moi",
    "AM_score",
    "mutation_root_parent",
    "PAI3D_score",
    "gnocchi_z"
  )

Lazy loading for filtering etc. We exclude: - Mutations below the unconstrained root - Mutations without any dates in the tree sequences See outputs of gel-summary_stats.Rmd for numbers of these specific mutations

ts_lf_merge <- scan_parquet_polars(file.path(paths$output_dir, "all-chr*-df.parquet")) |>
  dplyr::select(all_of(selected_columns)) |>
  compute() %>%
  filter(
    mutation_root_parent == FALSE & !is.na(mean_time)
  )

4 Additional stats

Add in AlphaMissense categories

## Case when R-side issue..
ts_lf_merge <- ts_lf_merge$with_columns(list(
  pl$when(pl$col("AM_score")$is_null())$
    then(pl$lit(NA_character_)$cast(pl$Utf8))$
    when(pl$col("AM_score") < 0.34)$
    then(pl$lit("Likely benign"))$
    when(pl$col("AM_score") < 0.564)$
    then(pl$lit("Ambiguous"))$
    otherwise(pl$lit("Likely pathogenic"))$
    alias("AM_pred")
))

Add in PrimateAI-3D categories

ts_lf_merge <- ts_lf_merge$with_columns(list(
  pl$when(pl$col("PAI3D_score")$is_null())$
    then(pl$lit(NA_character_)$cast(pl$Utf8))$
    when(pl$col("PAI3D_score") > 0.80)$
    then(pl$lit("Likely pathogenic"))$
    when(pl$col("PAI3D_score") < 0.60)$
    then(pl$lit("Likely benign"))$
    otherwise(pl$lit("Ambiguous"))$
    alias("PAI3D_pred")
))

Z-scoring ages

ts_lf_merge %<>%
z_normalise(
      group_col = "AC_ts",
      score_col = "mean_time",
      z_col = "time_z",
      log10 = TRUE
    )

Missense restricted (smaller) tibble

ts_df_missense <- ts_lf_merge %>%
  drop_na(AM_score) %>%
  as_tibble()

4.1 Summarise numbers across classes

  • AlphaMissense categories (singletons + ur)
  • PrimateAI-3D categories (singletons + ur)
  • PanelApp mode of inheritance categories (singletons + ur)
summarise_block <- function(df, group_var) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      under_100   = mean(mean_time < 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      n           = n(),
      g_mean_time = exp(mean(log(mean_time), na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n),
           grouping = as_string(ensym(group_var))) %>%
    rename(level = {{ group_var }})
}

# subsets
ultra_rare <- ts_df_missense %>% filter(AF_ts < 0.001)
singletons <- ts_df_missense %>% filter(AC_ts == 1)

# Ultra-rare blocks (mirror original behavior: keep MOI as-is; drop NA for AM/PAI)
ur_panel <- ultra_rare %>%
  summarise_block(panel_app_moi) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Ultra-rare (AF_ts < 0.001)")

ur_am <- ultra_rare %>%
  drop_na(AM_pred) %>%
  summarise_block(AM_pred) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Ultra-rare (AF_ts < 0.001)")

ur_pai <- ultra_rare %>%
  drop_na(PAI3D_pred) %>%
  summarise_block(PAI3D_pred) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Ultra-rare (AF_ts < 0.001)")

# Singleton blocks (mirror original behavior)
sg_panel <- singletons %>%
  summarise_block(panel_app_moi) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Singletons (AC_ts == 1)")

sg_am <- singletons %>%
  drop_na(AM_pred) %>%
  summarise_block(AM_pred) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Singletons (AC_ts == 1)")

sg_pai <- singletons %>%
  drop_na(PAI3D_pred) %>%
  summarise_block(PAI3D_pred) %>%
  mutate(subset = "Singletons (AC_ts == 1)")

# final table, same columns/statistics as before
stats_tbl <- bind_rows(
  ur_panel, ur_am, ur_pai,
  sg_panel, sg_am, sg_pai
) %>%
  dplyr::select(subset, grouping, level, under_100, n, g_mean_time, prop) %>%
  arrange(subset, grouping, desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    grouping = case_when(
      grouping == "AM_pred" ~ "AlphaMissense",
      grouping == "PAI3D_pred" ~ "PrimateAI-3D",
      grouping == "panel_app_moi" ~ "PanelApp gene mode of inheritance"
    )
  )

4.2 ECDF and AUROC plots by AC across classes

4.2.1 AlphaMissense

Define some plotting colours etc.

am_categories <- c(
  "Likely benign",
  "Ambiguous",
  "Likely pathogenic"
)

am_colors <- c(
  "Likely benign" = "#78B7C5",
  "Ambiguous" = "#EBCC2A",
  "Likely pathogenic" = "#EF5703"
)

Plot ECDF difference per AlphaMissense class stratified by AC 1-11

p_am_delta_by_ac <- ecdf_difference_by_ac_plot(
  df = ts_df_missense,
  time_col = "mean_time",
  group_col = "AM_pred",
  ac_col = "AC_ts",
  ac_vals = 1:11,
  group_vals = am_categories,
  reference_group = "Likely benign",
  log10 = TRUE,
  count_size = 10,
  x_limits = c(1, 100000),
  colors = am_colors,
  min_n = 20
) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(-0.05, 0.15)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10]~"allele age (generations)"),
    y = "Difference in ECDF\nvs Likely benign"
  )

We can then summarise this pattern using AUROC

p_am_ac_line <- ecdf_difference_ac_line_plot(
  df = ts_df_missense,
  time_col = "mean_time",
  group_col = "AM_pred",
  ac_col = "AC_ts",
  ac_vals = 1:15,
  group_vals = am_categories,
  reference_group = "Likely benign",
  log10 = TRUE,
  min_n = 100,
  metric = "auroc",
  trend_method = "lm",
  legend_title = "AlphaMissense class",
  show_se = FALSE,
  return_data = FALSE,
  colors = am_colors
) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.46, 0.62)) + 
labs(x = "Derived allele count", y = "AUROC\nP(class younger than likely benign)")

4.3 Singleton missense plots across classes

  • Log scaled ages by classes (box+whiskers)
  • Also Duncan’s sampling QQ plots

4.3.1 AlphaMissense

Box and whiskers plot

am_sing_quantiles <- make_age_cat_boxplot(
  ts_df_missense %>%
    filter(AC_ts == 1),
  cat_col   = AM_pred,
  categories = c("Likely benign", "Ambiguous", "Likely pathogenic"),
  colors     = c("#78B7C5", "#EBCC2A", "#EF5703"),
  x_var      = mean_time,
  title      = "Singletons (missense)"
)

Duncan’s QQ plot with 95% CIs

am_df = ts_df_missense %>%
  filter(AC_ts == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    shape_time, scale_time, AM_pred
  )

am_qq_data_singletons <- qq_plot_data_from_df(
  df = am_df,
  variable = "AM_pred",
  null_category = "Likely benign",
  num_bootstraps=as.integer(10),
  conf_percent = 95,
  num_points = as.integer(1000)
)

am_qq_plot <- make_age_qq_plot(
  am_qq_data_singletons,
  cat_col    = category,
  categories = c("Likely benign", "Ambiguous", "Likely pathogenic"),
  colors     = c("#78B7C5", "#EBCC2A", "#EF5703"),
  x_var      = null_times,
  y_ratio    = ratio,
  y_lower    = lower,
  y_upper    = upper,
  legend_title = "AlphaMissense class",
  control_level = "Likely benign",
)

4.3.2 PanelApp mode of inhertiance

Singletons box + whiskers by age

moi_sing_quantiles <- make_age_cat_boxplot(
  ts_df_missense %>%
    filter(AC_ts == 1 & panel_app_moi %in% c("Unknown", "BIALLELIC", "MONOALLELIC")),
  cat_col   = panel_app_moi,
  categories = c("Unknown", "BIALLELIC", "MONOALLELIC"),
  colors     = c("#74c476", "#238b45", "grey80"),
  x_var      = mean_time,
  title      = "Singletons (missense)"
)

Singeltons quantiles by age - Category = Unknown (no inhertiance pattern)

moi_df = ts_df_missense %>%
  filter(AC_ts == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    shape_time, scale_time, panel_app_moi
  ) %>%
  drop_na(panel_app_moi) %>%
  filter(panel_app_moi %in% c("Unknown", "BIALLELIC", "MONOALLELIC")) %>%
  mutate(
    ## Rename the categories.
    panel_app_moi = case_when(
      panel_app_moi == "BIALLELIC" ~ "Recessive inheritance",
      panel_app_moi == "MONOALLELIC" ~ "Dominant inheritance",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    )
  )

moi_qq_data_singletons <- qq_plot_data_from_df(
  df = moi_df,
  variable = "panel_app_moi",
  null_category = "None",
  conf_percent = as.integer(95),
  num_bootstraps= as.integer(10),
  num_points = as.integer(1000)
)

moi_qq_plot <- make_age_qq_plot(
  moi_qq_data_singletons,
  cat_col    = category,
  categories = c("None", "Recessive inheritance", "Dominant inheritance"),
  colors     = rev(c("#74c476", "#238b45", "grey80")),
  x_var      = null_times,
  y_ratio    = ratio,
  y_lower    = lower,
  y_upper    = upper,
  legend_title = "PanelApp inheritance class",
  control_level = "None",
)

4.4 Logistic regression of allele age Z-score bins vs probability of class membership

We can test the relationship between mutation age and different classes across the ur spectrum by looking at Z-score bins. - AlphaMissense categories (ur) - PrimateAI-3D categories (ur) - PanelApp mode of inheritance categories (ur)

4.4.1 AlphaMissense classes vs Frequency controlled allele age Z-scores bins

Make a plot of numbers of mutations per class

am_n_plot <- cat_n_plot(
  ts_df_missense,
  cat_col      = AM_pred,
  categories   = c("Likely pathogenic", "Ambiguous", "Likely benign"),
  colors       = c("#EF5703", "#EBCC2A", "#78B7C5"),
  filter_ac_ts = TRUE,
  AF_thresh    = 0.001,
  max_ac_fun   = max_ac_count,
  require_non_na = AM_score,
  x_divisor    = 1000,
  x_label      = "Missense variants (thousands)",
  title        = "GEL DAF < 0.1% (missense)",
  legend_title = "AlphaMissense class",
  show_legend  = FALSE
)

Run the logistic regression loop

am_logistic_test_z <-
outlier_logistic_loop_wrapper(
  df = ts_df_missense,
  outcome_col = "AM_pred",
  outcome_vec = c("Likely benign", "Ambiguous", "Likely pathogenic"),
  outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf), ## trim lower cateogories.
  outlier_col = "time_z",
  group_vals = c(1:max_ac_count(ts_lf_merge, AF_thresh = 0.001)),
  group_col = "AC_ts",
  direction = "between",
  correct_groups = FALSE,
  group_as_factor = FALSE
)
## Outlier column: time_z
am_logistic_test_z %<>%
mutate(outlier_score = gsub(" - ", " to ", outlier_score),
       outlier_score = case_when(
        outlier_score == "-Inf to -2" ~ "< -2",
        outlier_score == "4 to Inf" ~ "> 4",
        TRUE ~ outlier_score
       )) 
am_supp_table <- create_outlier_logistic_supp_table(
  test_results = am_logistic_test_z,
  source_df = ts_df_missense,
  csv_file = "data/alphamissense_age_z_logistic.csv",

  outcome_col = "AM_pred",
  outcome_vec = c(
    "Likely benign",
    "Ambiguous",
    "Likely pathogenic"
  ),

  outlier_col = "time_z",
  outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),

  group_col = "AC_ts",

4.4.2 PanelApp inheritance classes vs Frequency controlled allele age Z-scores bins

We expect that monoallelic vs biallelic inheritance would influence purifying selection. Is there a difference in age distributions of missense variants across clinically relevant recessive/dominant genes in terms of mutation ages, even when controlling for frequency?

We can look at PanelApp (https://panelapp.genomicsengland.co.uk/) for this. - gel-ts_df.Rmd annotated each variant with the mode of inheritance of any PanelApp gene they overlapped with.

Make a plot of numbers of missense mutations per class

moi_n_plot <- cat_n_plot(
  ts_df_missense,
  cat_col      = panel_app_moi,
  categories   = c("BIALLELIC", "MONOALLELIC", "Unknown"),
  colors       = c("#238b45", "#74c476", "grey80"),
  filter_ac_ts = TRUE,
  AF_thresh    = 0.001,
  max_ac_fun   = max_ac_count,
  require_non_na = panel_app_moi,
  x_divisor    = 1000,
  x_label      = "Missense variants (thousands)",
  title        = "GEL DAF < 0.1% (missense)",
  legend_title = "PanelApp inheritance class",
  show_legend  = FALSE
)

Run the logistic regression loop

moi_logistic_test_z <-
outlier_logistic_loop_wrapper(
   ts_df_missense %>%
    filter(panel_app_moi %in% c("BIALLELIC", "Unknown", "MONOALLELIC")),
  outcome_col = "panel_app_moi",
  outcome_vec = c("BIALLELIC", "Unknown", "MONOALLELIC"),
  outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),
  outlier_col = "time_z",
  group_vals = c(1:max_ac_count(ts_lf_merge, AF_thresh = 0.001)),
  group_col = "AC_ts",
  direction = "between",
  correct_groups = FALSE,
  group_as_factor = FALSE
)
## Outlier column: time_z
moi_logistic_test_z %<>%
mutate(outlier_score = gsub(" - ", " to ", outlier_score),
       outlier_score = case_when(
        outlier_score == "-Inf to -2" ~ "< -2",
        outlier_score == "4 to Inf" ~ "> 4",
        TRUE ~ outlier_score
       ))
moi_supp_table <- create_outlier_logistic_supp_table(
  test_results = moi_logistic_test_z,

  source_df = ts_df_missense %>%
    filter(
      panel_app_moi %in%
        c("BIALLELIC", "Unknown", "MONOALLELIC")
    ),

  csv_file = "data/moi_age_z_logistic.csv",

  outcome_col = "panel_app_moi",
  outcome_vec = c(
    "BIALLELIC",
    "Unknown",
    "MONOALLELIC"
  ),

  outlier_col = "time_z",
  outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),

  group_col = "AC_ts",
  group_vals = 1:max_ac_count(ts_lf_merge, AF_thresh = 0.001),

  direction = "between",
  
  outlier_label = "Ultra-rare (DAF < 0.1%) missense mutation frequency-controlled age Z-score",
  outcome_label = "Mode of inheritance class"
)

pai3d_zcat_plot <- pai3d_logistic_test_z %>%

)

missense_cat_plot <- ggarrange(

    nrow = 1

)

Ill manually annotate with some stuff too.

4.6 Constraint Z-score plot

gnomADv3.1 released Z-scores showing mutational constraint across chromosomes We can take a look at if there is any enrichment/depletion of allele frequency / allele age outliers (Z-scores) within constraint Z-score bins.

Z-scoring just across chromosome 17

ts_df_chr17 <- ts_lf_merge %>%
filter(chromosome == "chr17") %>%
dplyr::select(-time_z) %>%
z_normalise(
      group_col = "AC_ts",
      score_col = "mean_time",
      z_col = "time_z",
      log10 = TRUE
) %>% 
as_tibble()
## takes a while, checkpoint
checkpoint_gnocchi_regress <- paste0(
  paths$output_dir,
  "checkpoints/all-chr17-gnocchi_z-regression.tsv.gz"
)

cat("Gnocchi checkpoint:", checkpoint_gnocchi_regress, "\n")
## Gnocchi checkpoint: /pgen_int_work/BRS/dd/sam/projects/gel-dating-paper/output_data/checkpoints/all-chr17-gnocchi_z-regression.tsv.gz
if (file.exists(checkpoint_gnocchi_regress)) {

  cat("Loading existing Gnocchi regression checkpoint\n")

  gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z <- data.table::fread(
    checkpoint_gnocchi_regress
  )

} else {

  cat("Checkpoint not found; running Gnocchi regressions\n")

  gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z <-
    outlier_logistic_loop_wrapper(
      df = ts_df_chr17,
      outcome_col = "gnocchi_z",
      outcome_vec = c(
        "<n4", "n3-n4", "n2-n3", "n1-n2",
        "0-n1", "0-1", "1-2", "2-3", "3-4", ">=4"
      ),
      outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),
      outlier_col = "time_z",
      group_vals = 1:max_ac_count(
        ts_lf_merge,
        AF_thresh = 0.001
      ),
      group_col = "AC_ts",
      direction = "between",
      correct_groups = FALSE,
      group_as_factor = FALSE
    )

  data.table::fwrite(
    gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z,
    checkpoint_gnocchi_regress,
    sep = "\t"
  )
}
## Loading existing Gnocchi regression checkpoint
gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z %<>%
  mutate(
    outlier_score = gsub(
      " - ",
      " to ",
      outlier_score
    ),
    outlier_score = case_when(
      outlier_score == "-Inf to 0" ~ "< 0",
      outlier_score == "4 to Inf" ~ "> 4",
      TRUE ~ outlier_score
    )
  )
cat("Gnocchi results dimensions:",
    nrow(gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z),
    "x",
    ncol(gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z),
    "\n")
## Gnocchi results dimensions: 60 x 13
print(names(gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z))
##  [1] "estimate"       "std.error"      "statistic"      "p.value"       
##  [5] "conf.high"      "conf.low"       "p.adjust"       "gnocchi_z"     
##  [9] "outlier_score"  "outlier_method" "group"          "outcome"       
## [13] "direction"
gnocchi_supp_table <- create_outlier_logistic_supp_table(
  test_results = gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z,

  source_df = ts_df_chr17,

  csv_file = "data/gnocchi_age_z_logistic.csv",

  outcome_col = "gnocchi_z",

  outcome_vec = c(
    "<n4",
    "n3-n4",
    "n2-n3",
    "n1-n2",
    "0-n1",
    "0-1",
    "1-2",
    "2-3",
    "3-4",
    ">=4"
  ),

  outlier_col = "time_z",
  outlier_thresh_vec = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),

  group_col = "AC_ts",
  group_vals = 1:max_ac_count(ts_lf_merge, AF_thresh = 0.001),

  direction = "between",

  outlier_label = "Ultra-rare (DAF < 0.1%) mutation frequency-controlled age Z-score",
  outcome_label = "Gnocchi constraint category"
)

gnocchi_z_plot <- gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z %>%
enrichment_depletion_plot(
  group_col = "gnocchi_z",
  outlier_scores = unique(gnocchi_logistic_test_between_z$outlier_score),
  group_vals = order_constraint
) +
scale_fill_viridis(option = "A", discrete = TRUE) +
scale_color_viridis(option = "A", discrete = TRUE) +
labs(
  x = "Frequency-controlled age z-score bin",
  y = "Relative P(class membership)"
) +
coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
ggtitle("GEL DAF < 0.1%") +
theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),  # Match axis text size
    axis.text = element_text(size = rel(0.8))    # Adjust axis text size if needed
  )

Constraint Z scores

#### gnocchi constraint
constraint_gnocchi <- fread(
    file.path(paste0(paths$output,"all-chr17-gnocchi_constraint.tsv.gz"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(start > 18276569 & end < 26718757)
  )
gnocchi_plot_constraint <- constraint_gnocchi %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = 1, ymin = -1,
    gnocchi_z = factor(gnocchi_z, levels = order_constraint)
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = start/1e6, xmax = end/1e6,
        ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
        colour = gnocchi_z, fill = gnocchi_z),
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "A", discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "A", discrete = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Position (Mb)\nChromosome 17",
    fill   = "gnocchi constraint class (z-score bin)",
    colour = "gnocchi constraint class (z-score bin)"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust    = 0.5,
      nrow           = 1,
      label = FALSE,
      keywidth  = unit(25, "pt"),
      keyheight = unit(25, "pt")
    ),
    colour = "none"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position     = "top",
    legend.box          = "horizontal",
    legend.title.align  = 0.5,
    legend.spacing.x     = unit(3, "pt"),
    panel.grid          = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y         = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y        = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(18276569, 26718757)/1e6, linewidth = 0.5)
gnocchi_z_score_fig <- ggarrange(
  ggarrange(NULL, gnocchi_plot_constraint, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.07, 1)),
  NULL,
  gnocchi_z_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.65, 0.05, 1)
)
gnocchi_z_score_fig
